new_claims.statement: For one literal hub and leaf block D+V Lambda V^T, promote any literal leaf set S to physical hubs and retain all promoted densities. If the residual base Gram G_R=sum(V_j,c_j)(V_j,c_j)^T is positive and every residual leverage is <=1/2, then the full ambient quadratic form has a continuous density with ||p_Q||inf <= C_r[det(G_R)prod|lambda_q|]^(-1/(r+2)), C_r=4(r+2)/r*2^(-2/(r+2)), and the same linear interval coefficient. The enlarged Gram factors exactly as N diag(G_R,I_|S|)N^T, every retained promoted-hub weight equals one, and the Fourier exponent stays 1+r/2 independently of |S|.

For residual Gram G and literal row x_i of leverage ell_i, det(G-x_ix_i^T)=det(G)(1-ell_i). Repeated literal promotion therefore spends only residual determinant currency; ell_i=1 is an exact mixed-frame coloop certificate.

For disjoint leaf pairs I,J and leaf non-diagonal block V Lambda V^T, the fixed-hub third minor equals a sum over curvature 2-mode Pluecker products minus a sum over hub-curvature wedge products: a sum_{p<q}lambda_p lambda_q Delta_I^(pq)Delta_J^(pq)-sum_p lambda_p W_I^pW_J^p. For r<=4 the pair-feature rank is at most 10.
